title: A Drop for the Contact
author: Dominic Okafor
blurb: Casper Reyes, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
